title: Psalms 8
paragraphs: ¹ LORD, our Lord, how magnificent is your name throughout the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens. ² Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger. ³ When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers — the moon and the stars, which you have set in place — ⁴ what is mankind, that you are mindful of them? What are human beings, that you care for them? ⁵ Yet you have made them a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned them with glory and honor.

⁶ You have given them dominion over the works of your hands; you have put everything under their feet — ⁷ all flocks and herds, and the wild animals too, ⁸ the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and everything that moves through the currents of the sea. ⁹ LORD, our Lord, how magnificent is your name throughout the earth!
